summary: Insanity defense under IPC s.84; legal insanity vs medical insanity; test: inability to know nature of act or wrongfulness; burden of proof on accused by preponderance of probabilities; prosecution must disprove mens rea; court must examine conduct before/during/after; unsound mind at time of act required; Hamlet reference; HC judgment reversal sought but not decided on merits.
final_judgment: Appeal not decided on merits; court focused on legal standards for insanity defense without reversing or upholding conviction.
